answer: The strongest defense is quorum sampling: each scoring task draws a random beacon-selected panel of graders only from long-established identities with onyx-grade standing, the network's most trusted tier, earned slowly through verified history. Newcomers stay on the vine, accruing reputation before eligibility. An attacker must grow thousands of aged, high-standing fake identities over months, each risking slashing if caught, making sybil attacks costlier than the rewards they can capture.
